subject: Washington Titan I complexes (Larson Air Force Base region)
scope: Public historical education; broad county/regional context only, no exact site map, property entrances, personnel routes, operational procedures or active equipment.

chronology.event: Groundbreaking begins for three Larson AFB-region Titan I complexes
Washington Titan I complexes declared operational

documented_system_facts.claim: Washington's Larson-associated Titan I program used three complexes, with three missiles per complex.
HistoryLink reports silo depth of approximately 160 feet at the Washington sites.
Historical accounts document a hardened underground launch-control room.
General Titan I complexes incorporated linked underground support structures.
Titan I historically used a silo-to-surface lift rather than underground launch.
The Washington sites were retired in 1965 and became privately owned and closed to visitors.
The Quincy/Royal City complex has been reported flooded.
